name: CalTopo
description: Ingests map objects from a shared CalTopo map, or the live Shared Locations of a CalTopo Team Account, and posts them to the map. Optionally creates a CalTopo Map in a Team Account for every CoreEvent created.

permissions.description: CalTopo posts team, device, and map object locations to the map
Reads a CoreEvent before creating its CalTopo Map - an Event whose caltopo external ID is set is skipped and its links are kept when the Map link is appended - required by the Outgoing flow
Files the created CalTopo Map ID under the caltopo external ID of the CoreEvent and adds the Map URL to its links - required by the Outgoing flow

schedule.description: Polls CalTopo for updated team and map object locations on a schedule.

types.description: Creates a CalTopo Map in the configured Team Account titled after the CoreEvent callsign, with a Marker at the Event location carrying its remarks & location - the Map ID is filed under the caltopo external ID of the Event and, unless the Map is PRIVATE, its URL is added to the Event links
